scope: Bounded exploratory de-DE noun/finite-verb agreement; actual accepted CPU/F32 native annotations and pure Dart lexical guard; manual opt-in only if this gate and editor controls pass.

baseline.provider: GermanWritingRulesProvider with every current rule enabled except explicit per-case ignored IDs
baseline.note: Later independent Office changes may be reconciled before candidate freeze; current deterministic behavior must remain byte-identical except an additive reviewed-facts API, and the final source closure will be sealed.

qualification_panel.authorship: coordinating assistant; separate implementation agent; no human annotation or population sampling claim

development.policy: Separate authored development inputs and historical grammar panels may be used for implementation and debugging. They never increase qualification denominator. Every initial failure is retained.

arms: current deterministic plus native secondary via mergeOfficeProofingReports
scoring.exact_correction: For error cases, all reviewable replacement edits applied to original input must equal the frozen expected full string. No multiple-choice oracle picks; a finding must contain exactly one replacement.
scoring.valid_control: Report any finding and any changed valid text separately for each arm; reject any added native finding on a valid control even if merge hides it.
scoring.guard_control: Not asserted grammatical: require no native suggestion on protected, ignored, vocabulary, unsupported-structure or malformed-mark contexts; report baseline findings separately.
scoring.unsupported: Report explicit unsupported separately from clean success; do not count as false positive success or correction coverage.
scoring.merge: Deterministic findings keep precedence using existing merger; count raw model proposals and proposals suppressed by merge separately.
scoring.recheck: Re-analyze corrected error outputs with the same native candidate and planner; record any remaining model finding; these repeated executions are not additional independent cases.
scoring.offsets: Use nonzero UTF-16 request origin 23 in every panel case. Each finding must map exactly back to originalText and a source grapheme boundary.
scoring.operational: Failures/timeouts/cancellations/missing assets/status mismatches are counted separately and cannot be represented as clean results.

predeclared_gate.meaning: A finite incremental benefit on this authored panel only, not general German precision/recall or production release.

execution_order: Publish this protocol and panel before candidate output inspection.
Develop on separate data and retain initial failures.
Review and publish candidate, harness, and exact source/runtime hashes before reading qualification outputs.
Run qualification exactly once for this candidate; retain partial report on failure and never overwrite it.
If output-informed planner changes are needed, classify this panel as development and require a new independently frozen panel for a new qualification claim.
Publish outcome whether positive or negative; keep grammar default off and packaging separate.
